data.name: Window_Title
data.value: Set up ONNX GenAI text generation

data.name: Step1_Description
data.value: Python is required to download the prepared model package. Download the latest release here and enable “Add Python to PATH” during setup: https://www.python.org/downloads/

data.name: Step2_Headline
data.value: Download the Phi-4 ONNX GenAI model

data.name: Step2_Description
data.value: Open the included page and run or download the published Python script. The CPU INT4 model is about 10.9 GB. Pass --output-directory to select its destination: {0}

data.name: Step3_Description
data.value: Set ModelFolder to the selected --output-directory. It must contain genai_config.json, tokenizer.json, model.onnx, model.onnx.data, and the additional tokenizer assets downloaded by the script.
